text:
Can you describe if your double vision worsens when you look up or move your eyes in a specific direction, and do you notice any muscle weakness in your shoulders or neck?

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count, Creatine Kinase, and Antibody Panel for Myasthenia Gravis.
REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Cervical Spine.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibodies: Present (elevated), Electromyography: Decreased muscle response with repetitive stimulation, Chest_CT: Normal, no thymoma or other masses detected. NORMAL READINGS: Complete Blood Count, Creatine Kinase, Antibody Panel for Myasthenia Gravis, MRI Cervical Spine.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The presence of elevated acetylcholine receptor antibodies, along with your symptoms of double vision and fluctuating muscle weakness, confirms this diagnosis despite the normal CK and MRI findings. I will now prescribe symptomatic treatment and refer you to neurology for long-term management.
